findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing (50 nodes), and the curve support is [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and replaced by an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity target is observable and only coordinate contrasts are available.

Continuous landmark features show sign changes and strong sign conflicts across the observed window: e.g. landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts with first_rate_z -72.4 and last_rate_z +5.5, and landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts; no polynomial fit was accepted and extrapolation is disallowed for these rows.

Landmark_00_soft_mass has whole_window_z 0.639 with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, and landmark_00_local_cxx has whole_window_z -0.579 with 6 sign changes and 2 strong sign conflicts; these whole-window means are small relative to the large first/last rate z-values, indicating the rate structure is not a stable constant rule.

Branch-adjusted raw-covariance effects for global centroid coordinates are null: global_centroid_x p=0.595 q=0.722 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.5, global_centroid_y p=0.546 q=0.692 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.43, and global_centroid_z p=0.950 q=0.965 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.36; the centroid carries no reproducible signed contrast.

Shape components show weak, non-significant-after-multiplicity negative covariance effects: shape_xx p=0.096 q=0.232 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.79, shape_yy p=0.048 q=0.153 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.79, and shape_zz p=0.353 q=0.501 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.57; the consistent negative sign for xx and yy is suggestive but does not survive q-thresholding.

hypotheses.direction: Prefer a validated observed-node time-conditioned contrast over a constant landmark rule for the affected landmark coordinates.
hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant landmark rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on independent-batch agreement and sign consistency, the time-conditioning hypothesis is weakened.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy and landmark_00_local_dz observed-node contrast curves
hypotheses.scope: Observed score window [0.0,0.5], predicted endpoint world coordinates, 14 independent batches
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned landmark coordinate contrast may outperform a constant coordinate rule, because the observed landmark rate z-values change sign within the window while whole-window means remain small.

hypotheses.direction: Test a shape_xx/shape_yy negative-covariance coordinate contrast while leaving global centroid coordinates free.
hypotheses.falsifier: If shape_xx/shape_yy effects fail to replicate in independent batches or reverse sign, the shape-covariance hypothesis is weakened.
hypotheses.observable: branch-adjusted raw_covariance for shape_xx and shape_yy versus global_centroid_x/y/z
hypotheses.scope: Observed window, 14 independent batches, branch-adjusted covariance metric
hypotheses.statement: A shape-covariance coordinate contrast (negative xx/yy covariance direction) may carry a weak reproducible signal that is distinct from the null global-centroid contrast.

limitations: Recorded affinities were removed and replaced by an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity benefit or final-affinity outcome is observable; only coordinate contrasts are available.
No decoded terminal labels, survival credit, increment or turnover evidence was read in this turn, so last-record or descendant credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The continuous_trends rows read are limited to landmark_00 features; other landmarks and regional/joint diagnostics were not inspected.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
The endpoint pointcloud reward is a coordinate reward, not a physical interaction energy or evidence of neural-module causation.
